Existing before_delete supplies selected-table complete index checks, reciprocal/catalog agreement, complete stored FK membership and existing mutation-key allowlist. The new metadata helper alone grants no mutation authority; it runs after those gates using canonical before.schema.name, before request processing.

FK carriers retain exact paired Byte/Int16/Int32/Int64/Currency/GUID/Decimal metadata and identical Decimal precision/scale. Read coverage does not grant broader mutation rights. All-NULL child keys exempt; partial NULL tuples exact; one-to-one/many checks remain.

Child-only/unreferenced parent deletions use unchanged record/index mechanics. Full final touching-relationship membership rejects removed parent with surviving child as typed ConstraintViolation::MissingParent. Multiple edges all apply, with no partial candidate.

No new FK key encoder, matcher, cascade dispatcher or SQL statement/self-co-delete timing semantics. Existing self/cascade DELETE negatives remain unchanged and pass; no negative migration was needed.

Healthy unenforced causal fixture has ordinary indexes without reciprocal FK descriptors, passes structure/NotEnforced read checks, then empty and nonempty DELETE fail exact ConstraintCoverage. Earlier all-green test source is preserved; this adds no function count.

Properties/history/active-content, UPDATE/ignored-index, allocation/preservation, budget/cancel and non-journalable candidate gates remain. No ordinary ACE/backend SQL DELETE, macro eligibility or native Access save/reopen qualification.
